name: (Everything I Do) I Do It for You

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1991, featured in the Kevin Costner summer blockbuster "Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves." It spent seven weeks atop the Hot 100 and a record 16 weeks atop the UK singles chart, solidifying Adams's reputation as the "king of the soundtrack power ballad" in the 90s amidst a surge of alt-rock. "Adams courtly trifle from the Kevin Costner summer blockbuster Robin Hood Prince of thieves spent seven weeks atop the hot 100 and by the way a record 16 weeks atop the UK singles chart."

podcast.body: This song was the winner of the 1991 Billboard Song of the Summer. It originated from the soundtrack of the Kevin Costner blockbuster "Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves" and is described as an "inescapable, sometimes insufferable" ballad. "In 9th place, 1991's song of the summer came off the soundtrack to the Kevin Costner blockbuster Robin Hood Prince of Thieves."

podcast.body: Produced by Mut Lang, this song spent an unprecedented 16 weeks at number one on the official UK singles chart, breaking Slim Whitman's 1955 record of 11 weeks for "Rose Marie" and setting a new benchmark for UK chart longevity. "a hit by Brian Adams in 1991 spent 16 weeks official UK chart and that single was produced by you guessed it, Mut Lang."
